title: Lassis Inn

buildingCutout.basis: The named restaurant footprint at 518 East 27th Street from OpenStreetMap way 952748548.

terrainReference.basis: Parking apron below the south entrance steps.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap building footprint at 518 East 27th Street, corroborated by the City of Little Rock and the Qualla photographs.
mapIdentity.scope: Lassis Inn’s compact blue-sided restaurant at 518 East 27th Street in Little Rock, as photographed July 5, 2024. The scope includes the false-front parapet, awning, signage, concrete stair and attached side ramp.

note: The named mapped footprint controls the alignment. The dated photographs show both side elevations and fix the storefront, sign, door and attached side access. Roof heights, rear openings and ramp details are estimated.
